hits.title: Show HN: Garlic a onion metadata search engine

story_text.value:
For years, I've been frustrated with the state of search on the Tor network. Most .onion search engines return a huge number of dead links, outdated results, and have clunky interfaces.

That's why I've been working on Carrot Web, a new Tor search engine built from the ground up to fix these problems.

What makes it different?

Real-Time Link Verification: Every single link in the search results is checked for activity in real-time. Broken or inactive sites are automatically filtered out, so you don't waste your time.

Sophisticated Ranking: It goes beyond simple keyword matching. Carrot Web uses a custom ranking algorithm to prioritize more relevant and useful onion sites.

Simple & Clean Interface: No clutter, no distractions. Just a straightforward search experience that focuses on speed and efficiency.

This is a passion project, and for it to truly improve, I need feedback from the community. Please give it a try and let me know what you think.

Test it out here: j5dkeyccbahuehkuggd3uhcu2paanxjl7n7tz2fs5koxugrclhpxxyyd.onion (Make sure to use Tor Browser)

All your thoughts, good or bad, are highly appreciated. Thanks!
